name: savepage-swallow
description: Cmd+S on a window with no sidebar is declined at the Atrium ExecuteCommand intercept - which is intended - and is then lost downstream in the responder chain, so native Save Page never runs. These gates started life in little-window-tab, where they did not belong: that scenario grades the claim about what is INSIDE a little window, and a red save-page gate there made a passing scenario look like a failing one. This scenario owns the swallow and nothing else. It reproduces little-window-tab's premise exactly - same fixture, same startup space, same Cmd+Opt+N, same wait for the little window's own tab 2 to commit - and only then presses Cmd+S. It is RED until the swallow is fixed, and that is the correct reading. The companion savepage-control presses the identical chord on an ordinary window and is the negative control for harness delivery.

actions.note: The default binding for OpenLittleWindow. A little window has no sidebar, which is the condition this scenario is about.

premise, not the measurement: without a tab there is nothing for Save Page to act on and a miss downstream would mean nothing. Hardcoded to id 2 because the fixture's startup space restores exactly one tab (id 1) before the hotkey fires, so id 2 is deterministically the little window's own tab.

a real http(s) scheme rather than a named host. The url is kLittleWindowDefaultURL, a constexpr in atrium_browser_controller.cc, so no fixture edit could repoint it - and naming example.com tied this gate to a host the probe VM is not meant to reach without adding anything to what it proves.
THE CHORD. The little window is key at this point (Cmd+Opt+N opened and focused it), so Cmd+S targets ITS tab, id 2.

THE MEASUREMENT. Save Page reached the little window's OWN tab. Anchored to tab 2 so the assertion cannot be satisfied by the chord landing on the startup window instead. Measured red on 2026-08-11: zero matches in the run log, because the command is declined at the intercept and never returns at before_first_responder=0.

let the save sheet actually appear before trying to dismiss it. The wait_vlog above matches at chrome::SavePage entry, but the panel is shown later - SavePackage::GetSaveInfo hops to a background thread for the default download directory first. Measured on 2026-08-11: the escape fired 3s before Cmd+Q and the sheet was still up, which stalled the browser message loop for 9.83s between 'KeepAlives=[]' and GCM shutdown and made quit miss its 10s budget. The three earlier runs took 12-36ms across that same span, because Save Page never ran in them.
dismiss the save sheet, if one ever appears, so the quit assertion is not blocked by a modal
sheet teardown finishes before the assertions and Cmd+Q run
second dismissal in case the first still raced the panel. Escape on a page with no dialog is a no-op, so this cannot change the measurement.

assertions.desc: one startup window plus the little one - liveness, and proof the chord had a sidebar-less window to land on

assertions.label: little-tab-committed
assertions.note: a real http(s) scheme rather than a named host. The url is kLittleWindowDefaultURL, a constexpr in atrium_browser_controller.cc, so no fixture edit could repoint it - and naming example.com tied this gate to a host the probe VM is not meant to reach without adding anything to what it proves.

assertions.label: intercept-declined
assertions.pattern: Atrium: execute command 35004 before_first_responder=1 sidebar_toggle_available=0 claimed=0
assertions.note: And currently GREEN. 35004 is IDC_SAVE_PAGE. Declining here is correct - a window with no sidebar must not claim Cmd+S. This assertion exists so a fix that repairs the swallow by making the intercept claim the command anyway is caught as a regression rather than mistaken for a fix.

assertions.label: little-save-page
assertions.note: And THE ASSERTION THIS SCENARIO EXISTS FOR. RED until the swallow is fixed. A declined command must fall through to the window's command handler; today it does not, and Save Page never runs.

assertions.desc: Cmd+Q still quits with a little window open
